claims.text: When the control link is lost, try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft; if the connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: If the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.
claims.quote: If the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.

claims.text: The capabilities of the small UAS will govern the remote PIC's determination as to the appropriate course of action.
claims.quote: The capabilities of the small UAS will govern the remote PIC's determination as to the appropriate course of action.
conditions: control decision governed by aircraft capabilities

claims.text: The remote PIC may need to land the small unmanned aircraft immediately, enter hover mode, or employ a return-to-home sequence as part of pre-determined loss of VLOS procedures.
claims.quote: The remote PIC may need to land the small unmanned aircraft immediately, enter hover mode, or employ a return-to-home sequence.
conditions: loss of VLOS cannot be regained
pre-determined procedures for loss of VLOS

claims.text: The manual states that, when the remote controller signal is lost, "The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover".
claims.quote: The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover
conditions: if the remote controller signal is lost
Signal Lost Action is set to RTH, land, or hover

claims.quote: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings
conditions: RTH is initiated due to lost link

claims.text: The manual states that "The RTH altitude is related to the Home Point."

claims.quote: The aircraft cannot avoid obstacles during failsafe RTH when there is insufficient light

claims.text: When a lost link occurs, the UAS performs RTH at programmed altitude.
claims.quote: UAS RTH at programmed altitude without issue.

claims.text: Repeated testing shows interference with the flight controller within 5 feet of the antenna.
